newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DEGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DEGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Riyadh Governor Prince Salman began a three-day visit to France and will visit France President Jacques Chirac, Prime Minister Alian Juppe and other high-ranking officials.
- The Jeddah chapter of the Pakistan Women's Group raised 32,000 riyals in aid of Pakistani victims of the Mena haj fire which killed 343 pilgrims.
- Health ministry to spend 215 million riyals to build hospitals in Saudi Arabia's northern province.
- Around 20 Saudi firms are to participate in the "Lebanon Project 97" exhibition in Beirut on May 20.
- Saudi firms launch a new drive against fake goods.
